verdict.rationale: CIPO is Canada's national intellectual-property office. It runs trademark, patent and design filing services and public registries, and those records are held by the office itself. A user-selectable storage region is a category error for this kind of government registry, and nothing in the evidence shows CIPO offering any residency choice.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
